request: Investigate the delay on order ORD-1011.

steps.text: I will look up the order’s details to see its promised delivery date, fulfillment status, and warehouse so I can determine if it’s overdue and where to investigate next.
I will retrieve the shipment status and tracking events to confirm if the delivery is overdue and see any carrier-reported delay, ETA changes, or stalled tracking.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1011 is overdue by 2 days versus the promised delivery date 2026-03-14. The shipment was handed to the carrier 4 days after the ship-by date and is currently in transit with ETA 2026-03-17.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1011 fulfillment_status SHIPPED, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-14, fulfillment_warehouse_id WH-ATL, is_past_promised_date true.
get_shipment_status: SHP-5011 carrier Harbor Express tracking HBX-12077 status IN_TRANSIT, dispatch_date 2026-03-13, ship_by_date 2026-03-09, dispatched_late true (dispatch_days_after_ship_by 4).
get_shipment_status: SHP-5011 is_overdue true, days_past_promised_date 2, current_estimated_delivery_date 2026-03-17 (ETA after promised date).
get_shipment_status: last_event 2026-03-15 at Richmond, VA, days_since_last_event 1, recorded_delay_reason null.
arguments.likely_cause: Late warehouse dispatch: shipment left WH-ATL on 2026-03-13, which is 4 days after the 2026-03-09 ship-by date.
uncertainties: The root reason for the warehouse’s late handoff is not in the data.
Whether Harbor Express will meet the 2026-03-17 ETA is not confirmed by the carrier beyond tracking events.

recommended_actions.details: Inform Wide World Importers that the order is delayed past the 2026-03-14 promise and is currently estimated to deliver on 2026-03-17 per get_shipment_status (SHP-5011 ETA 2026-03-17).

Ask Harbor Express to confirm current location and delivery commitment for tracking HBX-12077, since the order is overdue (get_shipment_status: is_overdue true, days_past_promised_date 2) and no delay reason is recorded.

Request WH-ATL to explain why dispatch occurred on 2026-03-13, 4 days after the 2026-03-09 ship-by date (get_shipment_status: dispatched_late true), and to implement corrective actions to prevent late handoffs.

arguments.recommendation: Notify the customer of the new ETA, request a status/ETA confirmation from Harbor Express, and escalate to WH-ATL about the 4-day late dispatch.
